headline: Foxcicle Aurora Guide
title: Foxcicle | Aurora Guide Ice Pal Attack Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Running an Ice team? Add Foxcicle. Its partner skill, Aurora Guide, raises the Attack of Ice Pals by fifteen to thirty percent while it is in your party, and it does not stack. At base it is a top Cooling worker at level four, with Farming at level three. It sometimes drops Ice Organs on a Ranch. Is Foxcicle on your Ice team? Comment below!
description: Foxcicle in Palworld 1.0: Aurora Guide boosts Ice Pal Attack by 15 to 30 percent, with Cooling at level four and Farming at level three.
